summary: Full backend + frontend smoke tested. 33/33 pytest backend tests PASS covering auth, dashboard KPIs, stock CRUD + movements (entrada/saida/insufficient/low_stock), settings (admin update + funcionario forbidden), picagem (far rejected 403, near entrada→saida toggle, entries scoped per role), staff mgmt (create funcionario with per-module permissions, update role/permissions, delete, cannot-delete-self, funcionario 403 on stock/staff/invoices/settings but 200 on GET products & timeclock), consumo (stock deduction + value calc), faturação (23% VAT calc 26/5.98/31.98, invoice number FT YYYY/NNNN, sync sets emitida+external_synced). Frontend UI: login flow, dashboard KPIs render, navigation to all 7 pages (nav-painel/picagem/stock/consumo/staff/faturacao/definicoes) works, settings form saves, all CTAs (btn-add-product, btn-add-staff, btn-add-consumo, btn-add-invoice, btn-punch) present, clock-status renders 'FORA DE SERVIÇO'.

issues: Displays plaintext credentials 'admin@restaurante.pt / admin123' below the login button — convenient for demo but should be removed for production

action_items: (Optional) Consider removing hardcoded demo credentials hint on Login screen for production hardening.
Note: the review_request referenced testid 'nav-settings' but actual implementation uses 'nav-definicoes' (route /definicoes). Aligned; no fix required, just informational.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 597 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, staff, stock, timeclock, consumo, invoices, dashboard) if it continues to grow.

CORSMiddleware defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for credentialed requests. Not an issue currently (JWT via Authorization header, not cookies), but if cookie-based auth is added later, explicit origin list required.
haversine + settings coords are stored as loose dict fields; consider Pydantic validation on lat/lng range (-90..90 / -180..180) to prevent invalid data via PUT /api/settings.

clock_entries visibility: funcionario with 'picagem' perm but role=funcionario correctly sees only own entries; admin/gestor see all — logic is correct but tightly coupled, worth extracting into a scoped-query helper.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ prefixed products, one TEST funcionario user (deleted at end of run), settings row set to Lisbon coords (38.7223,-9.1393) radius 150m, 2 sample invoices.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. It self-configures settings via session fixture, so picagem tests work regardless of xdist worker ordering. pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope. To re-run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`.
